Project Easy-to-use-and-edit-guild-page-maker-system-super-deluxe

Places of Use

  • On the Guilds page.

Extension Used Yes/No? - Yes

An extension, or rather a javascript is being used along with the extension ParserFunctions to let it function well. No further info needed for wiki contributors/editors/visitors. For sysops: You can find the script and edit the text Here.

Purpose

It creates a text within the edit text box with steps how to make a guild page, so its basically fill in work. The text that is shown in the edit box can be foundHere (Accessable for Sysops only).

Credits & People working on it

Project Sound

Adding Sounds to various pages.

Places of Use

  • NPC's
  • Dungeons
  • Skills
  • Monsters
  • Items (On just a few pages)

Extension Used Yes/No? - Yes

The Extension that is being used for this project is the FlashMP3 extension

Configuration

See Mediawiki Extension Page.

Points of Interest

  • Uses Flash.
  • Supports only .mp3 files.
  • Does not support files bigger then 5 MB.

Project: Dungeon Maps and Outlines

This project is pretty well complete. All dungeons through The Shadow's Embrace have horizontal schematic maps followed by outline tables that are designed to print on one page. After that are the dungeon details.

Corrections and additions are still needed, as well as details for Balzack's Burrow.

The main thing to be done now is to map and detail Rasputin's Gulag. A lot of help is needed on dungeon levels, monsters, and quests for this dungeon.

Update All dungeons through Ratsputin's Gulag are pretty much up to date for Build 137, and mostly that covers build 147 too. Mutant Mania needs lots of work. HELP WANTED! --Catwalksbyhimself 20:47, 13 October 2008 (CEST)

People working on it

--Catwalksbyhimself 06:08, 29 June 2008 (CEST)
